To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the philosophy of medicine is an interdisciplinary field of research and that the philosophy of medical practice is a practical field of application.

philosophy can and should be taught to medical students in a way that helps them to understand the nature of the human being, the nature of medicine, the nature of the patient, the nature of disease and the nature of the physician-patient encounter, and to develop a sense of responsibility and compassion for patients and their relatives.
philosophy should be taught in order to help students to develop their own personal and ethical values, and also to help them to understand the role of philosophy in the development of medicine.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of philosophy in the process of medical education, and it is based on the conviction that philosophy is a part of medical humanities, which is an indispensable component of medical education.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
philosophy, in its broadest sense, is an indispensable part of medical education.
a medical professional, in order to be a truly competent and responsible person, must possess a set of skills and competences that cannot be acquired by means of a purely technical training.
the philosophy of medicine is not only a subject to be taught to the medical students, but also an activity to be carried out in the process of medical training and education.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
philosophy can be of great help in the process of medicalization of the patient, and that it can also be of use in the medicalization of the physician.
philosophy should not be taught to medical students as a separate discipline.
the philosophy of medicine should be understood as a philosophical discipline that deals with the problems of medicine as a human activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the role of a philosopher is to help a student to understand the nature of the medical profession.
a medical professional is not a mere technician, who has to be trained to perform certain procedures.
philosophy can be of great help in teaching medical students to think critically about their own professional practice.
